title: JainLLM Source Registry v1
description: Metadata registry for all external Jain sources. Every source that enters the JainLLM knowledge system must be registered here before acquisition, ingestion, or training. Availability on JainQQ or Jainebooks MUST NOT automatically imply permission to train.

platform.description: Platform where the source is hosted or acquired from

commentator.description: Commentator if the source is a commentary

translator.description: Translator if the source is a translation

download_available.description: Whether the source can be downloaded

retrieval_candidate.description: Whether this source is a candidate for the retrieval corpus

sft_candidate.description: Whether this source is a candidate for SFT training (requires CLEAR rights)

rights_model.description: Rights clearance model for external sources
rules: Availability on JainQQ or Jainebooks does NOT imply training permission
rights_status=CLEAR requires an explicit license or verified public domain status
sft_candidate=true requires rights_status=CLEAR and a verified license/publication date
retrieval_candidate may be true even if rights_status is not CLEAR (RAG-only path)

rights_statuses.CLEAR: Rights verified as permitting training use (explicit license, or verified public domain by age)
rights_statuses.PERMISSION_REQUIRED: Rights holder must grant permission before training use
rights_statuses.UNCLEAR: Rights status cannot be determined from available evidence
rights_statuses.RESTRICTED: Rights explicitly prohibit training use (e.g. NoDerivatives, NC without NC lane)

JAINQQ.role: Agam/canonical source discovery; Sthanakavasi editions; multilingual textual editions; source text acquisition
JAINQQ.acquisition_method: Catalogue discovery via web interface; text acquisition requires manual or API-based download
JAINQQ.training_implication: Source discovery only. Texts acquired from JainQQ must still pass rights gate before training.

JAINEBOOKS.role: Broad Jain literature discovery; books, magazines, pravachan, teacher material, practice material, biographies, secondary literature
JAINEBOOKS.acquisition_method: MCP-based catalogue discovery. Jainebooks MCP is an ACQUISITION/RESEARCH interface, NOT an inference backend.
JAINEBOOKS.training_implication: Catalogue discovery only. Jainebooks MCP must NOT be part of model inference pipeline. Texts require rights clearance.
